hyperedges.label: Change-quantity request flow through hexagonal layers
M3 features: storage locations, expiry query, minimum amount, filter/paging

nodes.label: Item list filter and paging
nodes.rationale: Filtering/sorting in the DB via JPA Specifications; sort by name then id for stable paging.

nodes.label: Minimum amount (Mindestbestand)
nodes.rationale: No separate unit so a minimum in kg vs quantity in pieces cannot arise; isBelowMinimum is strictly less-than; basis for M4 shopping list.

nodes.label: Expiry date and injected Clock
nodes.rationale: 'today' comes from a java.time.Clock injected into PantryItemService (ClockConfiguration with time zone Europe/Berlin; Clock.fixed in tests) so results are deterministic and time-zone-correct; Clock is JDK so no own port needed.

nodes.label: Default storage location 'Vorrat'
nodes.rationale: Fixed ID StorageLocationId.DEFAULT created by migration V2; the application, not the DB, sets it as default for new items.

nodes.label: Flyway migrations V1-V4
nodes.rationale: Schema changed only via new Flyway files, never editing executed ones; Hibernate ddl-auto validate. NUMERIC without scale keeps BigDecimal equality.

nodes.label: Invariant (constructor validation)
nodes.rationale: Every class validates its rules in the constructor (IllegalArgumentException), so no invalid object can exist; domain stays the real safeguard even though request DTOs use Bean Validation.

nodes.label: Cross-aggregate reference by ID
nodes.rationale: PantryItem holds only StorageLocationId: separate aggregates changed independently; avoids loading the location with each item and accidental cross-modification. Persistence mirrors this with a plain UUID column instead of @ManyToOne, with a DB foreign key.

nodes.label: Domain class separated from JPA entity
nodes.norm_label: domain class separated from jpa entity
nodes.rationale: JPA needs no-arg constructor and mutable fields plus Jakarta dependency, which ArchitectureTest forbids in domain; toDomain() re-runs domain validation on load.

nodes.label: Optional: Web-Frontend, Barcode-Scan (Open Food Facts), expiry notifications
nodes.norm_label: optional: web-frontend, barcode-scan (open food facts), expiry notifications

nodes.label: PageQuery / ResultPage (own paging types)
nodes.rationale: Own types instead of Spring Data Pageable/Page keep application independent of persistence technology; JpaPantryItemRepository translates to PageRequest.

nodes.label: Ports & Adapters Architecture
nodes.rationale: Dependency direction Adapter -> Application -> Domain, never reversed; enforced by ArchitectureTest (ArchUnit).
